description: 40 additional/local S0 GWT proposals: 18 SIG + 6 PAY-ABS candidates from existing 168-ID inventory, 16 newly proposed local PR-00/08/17/20 tests outside original 132

cases.title: Verified authorized signer on exact QuoteVersion
cases.given: A versioned immutable Quote PDF/hash and claimed signer/legal entity are available
cases.when: Server validates signed bytes and signer authority against approved legal profile
cases.then: ALLOW only when exact bytes, trusted certificate, authority and applicable legal decision are confirmed; otherwise HOLD
cases.dbOracle: Persist signed evidence referring to exact quote hash; no evidence overwrite
cases.sideEffectOracle: No binding QuoteAccepted/CarrierCommitted without verified original and approved signer authority
cases.httpUiOracle: Typed DENY/HOLD or explicitly conditional success after approved legal policy

cases.title: Changed document after signature
cases.given: An original legally signed document/hash is stored
cases.when: Replace one byte before verification
cases.then: DENY mismatched signature; issued quote remains unchanged
cases.dbOracle: No QuoteAccepted, no false proof
cases.sideEffectOracle: No binding QuoteAccepted/CarrierCommitted without verified original and approved signer authority
cases.httpUiOracle: Typed DENY/HOLD or explicitly conditional success after approved legal policy

cases.title: Certificate revoked
cases.given: Certificate validity/revocation source is authoritative and reachable

cases.then: DENY or HOLD according to approved policy; never silently ACCEPT
cases.dbOracle: No binding commitment or QuoteAccepted
cases.sideEffectOracle: No binding QuoteAccepted/CarrierCommitted without verified original and approved signer authority
cases.httpUiOracle: Typed DENY/HOLD or explicitly conditional success after approved legal policy

cases.title: Expired certificate or invalid signing instant

cases.dbOracle: No accepted document state

cases.httpUiOracle: Typed DENY/HOLD or explicitly conditional success after approved legal policy
